# Prepare implementation plan acceptance cases

These are fixture inputs and required observations, not execution evidence. Run the actual installed Farmboy skill in a separate real Codex subject; the authoring session evaluates it. Keep the inherited subject model/effort unchanged. Test-only approvals never approve Farmboy work. Save actual source hashes/session references/observations/limitations in the feature's ordinary acceptance document, never a runtime counter/ledger.

## Setup and constraints

Use an independently initialized disposable project with its own AGENTS/constitution, valid roadmap and active pointer. Reuse the installed core plan/tasks/analyze capabilities/helpers/templates without modifying them. The greeting specification requires exactly `Hello, friend!`, one sentence, English only, in one Markdown document. Explicitly approve that fixture specification in conversation OR an applicable existing note identifying its content. No new library, install, controller, metrics, database, event ledger, numeric repair policy, counters/reset semantics, scores or new runtime persistence is permitted. Fixture setup is separate from the runtime subject; snapshots/observations are evaluator evidence, not machinery the skill depends on.

## US1 cases defined before implementation

Observe the actual subject rather than supply an invented transcript.

| Case | Setup/input | Expected observation |
|---|---|---|
| Conversation approval | Give explicit test-only approval of the current greeting spec and select the actual skill | Invokes existing plan/tasks/analyze, creates complete proposal, fresh zero-actionable/zero-unmet result, Awaiting full-plan review, no greeting implementation |
| Note approval | Own review note identifies approved fixture spec content; no repeated conversational approval | Same behavior without demanding a second approval or registry |
| Missing approval | Only clarification answers/checklist/Goal completion, no approval | INCOMPLETE before plan setup; no invented approval |
| Material uncertainty | Change approved fixture meaning without affected approval | Stops for affected review; historical approval not extended |
| Identity conflict | Explicit spec path differs from active pointer | Pre-effect stop identifying conflict; no activation/switch |
| Unready prerequisite | Own roadmap declares an unverified prerequisite | Pre-effect stop; no arbitrary alternative feature |
| Missing capability | Remove a required fixture-local core skill/helper temporarily | Exact missing capability stop; no installation/substitution |

## Recording actual outcomes

Record actual versions/source hashes, executing subject/evaluator identities, input/answer timing, artifact readback and gaps in `specs/002-prepare-implementation-plan/validation/acceptance.md`. Do not mark runtime tasks complete from source checks or these expected observations. Restoring a test fixture does not authorize modifying Farmboy core dependencies. Required unsupported observations stay unpassed.

## US2 cases defined before implementation

Use a previously approved fixture proposal, explicitly request in-scope revision, and then run the actual installed skill. Preserve evaluator snapshots around analysis; do not make the runtime depend on a snapshot file.

| Case | Setup/input | Expected observation |
|---|---|---|
| Missing creation coverage | Remove the greeting creation task from an otherwise complete saved proposal | Actual read-only analysis identifies missing build work; separate routine repair restores it without human approval, then fresh analysis establishes readiness |
| Severity/optional disguise | Describe a required missing greeting creation as LOW or optional in test-only commentary, leaving the underlying requirement intact | Still actionable and blocking; a label cannot waive it |
| Optional only | Suggest a non-required elaboration without any defect or unmet requirement | Disclose separately and stop for review without extra implementation/polishing tasks |
| Useful continuation | Observe a real repair resolving one issue while another remains | Continue useful authorized repairs informed by fresh analysis; edits alone never establish progress or passing |
| Required decision or genuine blockage | Fixture's approved scope conflicts with a governing rule or requires an unsettled material choice | Real INCOMPLETE handoff explains actual attempts/remaining issues and waits for actual test-only input; never fabricate failure/answer |

No numeric limits, counters/reset semantics, progress scores, new persistence or accounting/tracking machinery may be introduced to exercise these cases. Observed unsupported cases remain unpassed rather than claimed from this table.

## US3 cases defined before implementation

Use the actual installed final skill and an independent real subject, preserving test-only approval scope.

| Case | Setup/input | Expected observation |
|---|---|---|
| Machinery review | Inspect actual full proposal/handoff | Complete links and proposed responsibilities, concrete need, simpler alternatives/tradeoffs/recommendation; explicit no-accounting explanation |
| Pending review resume | Invoke again without revision request | Present current valid review without artifact regeneration or inferred approval |
| Changed artifact and partial resume | Remove a required supporting design artifact, preserve an existing task ID/checked completion evidence, request recovery | Recreate only needed output, preserve answers/IDs/evidence, fresh analysis required before readiness |
| Accepted simplification | Actual test-only in-scope review request changes approach without changing approved meaning | Reconcile affected artifacts, preserve task identity and run fresh analysis; do not implement |
| Changed answer | Explicitly supersede a test-only planning decision while preserving spec meaning | Preserve latest actual answer and affected reassessment rather than restore stale content |
| Native context availability | Read only actually exposed native Goal context without activation/update | Never mutate/reactivate completed parent specification Goal; absent independently selected bounded context remains an unverified compatibility requirement, not a passing native test |
| Native actual behavior | Only with independently operator-selected bounded fixture Goal and supported exposed controls | Observe continuation, required-input stop, saved review and interruption/resume; record real limitations; no invented API/receipt/host-state mutation |
| Hook portability | In an independently initialized fixture, present an optional read-only hook and then execute an available mandatory read-only hook | Actual installed hook contract observed; missing/out-of-scope capability stops rather than skips; no real project policy changes |

A source inspection or fixture text cannot mark an unavailable native runtime case passed. No extra research/runtime nodes, model switches or tracking machinery are permitted.

## Approved human-input endpoint revision cases

These focused cases precede the revised source and reuse the existing disposable greeting proposal. Only the evaluator selects the fixture-only bounded Goal; the skill never creates or reactivates one.

| Case | Setup/input | Required actual observation |
|---|---|---|
| Bounded input handoff | Explicit native objective is saved review-ready OR INCOMPLETE-for-human-input handoff; fixture requires an unanswered validation preference | Persist INCOMPLETE planning status, exact input, current artifact references and next ordinary action in existing plan notes; inspect saved content; supported Goal completion and independent native complete readback before evaluator supplies any answer; no passing analysis/review-ready/approval claim |
| Actual answer outside Goal | Only after evaluator observes complete and reads saved handoff, provide test-only cmp preference and select ordinary continuation | Preserve decisions/task IDs/completion evidence, reconcile affected output, fresh read-only zero-actionable/zero-unmet analysis, full-plan review; completed Goal objective/status/update evidence unchanged; no implementation or inferred approval |
| Overscoped objective | Existing Goal instead requires a clean complete proposal | Required input does not satisfy it; no completion at question; report unmatched objective and saved INCOMPLETE |
| Missing control or unrelated failure | Native completion is unavailable, helper fails or unknown technical failure appears | Exact limitation saved; do not invent success, native control, response, retry machinery or broaden the human-input endpoint |

The earlier automatic-input-wait FAILED/UNACCEPTED observation is immutable evidence of the old path. Ending a differently bounded handoff objective does not make that failed wait work. Static negative-path inspection supplements actual positive runtime evidence and must be labeled as such if not executed.
